content: Figure FIGREF7 illustrate these two approaches. The audio signal is split into a sequence of left neighbour segment, target segment and right neighbour segment. In the first approach (left side on figure FIGREF7), the concatenation of the left neighbour segment and right neighbour segment ($Y$) is input to a VAE modelBIBREF16, and target window ($X$) is predicted. In the second approach (right side on figure FIGREF7) the target window ($X$) is the input to a VAE model, and neighbour window ($Y$) is predicted.
